wordmark.purpose: The Stimming mark in B612: menu title, toy header, Bar v2 logo. Each letter has its own weight, tilt and lift.

display.purpose: The toy's name above the vignette. Hidden today with its section.

intro-name.purpose: The title in the Signal intro. It scales with the shorter side of the screen.

headline.purpose: The series name in a Wave divider, in the series colour.

body.purpose: The toy page default. The menu sets 16 px / 1.3.

label.purpose: All Bar v2 control text: slab caps. 12 px on coarse pointers.

toy-label.purpose: The name under each menu icon, in slab caps.

keycap.purpose: Keys in the strip, on actions and in sheet headers. 9 to 10 px.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: A hovered Bar v2 control, with translate(-1px, -1px). Mouse screens only.

shadows.name: shadow
shadows.purpose: A picked chip, an open Settings or tray button.

shadows.name: hard
shadows.purpose: Sheets: Settings, Dev and the choice tray.

shadows.name: halo
shadows.purpose: A text-shadow that keeps the key strip legible on bright stages.

shadows.name: intro-glass
shadows.purpose: A backdrop-filter: the Signal intro blurs and dims the page behind it.

shadows.name: v1-frost
shadows.purpose: A backdrop-filter behind v1 controls that sit on a stage; v1 trays use blur(14px).

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Bar v2 colour, border, lift and shadow changes.

motion.name: quiet-link
motion.purpose: Colour changes on quiet links and v1 chips.

motion.name: chip-press-spring
motion.purpose: A v1 chip springs back from scale(0.94).

motion.name: corner-entrance
motion.purpose: Bar v2 corners slide in 6 px from their edges after the intro, 60 ms apart.

motion.name: build-split
motion.purpose: The Classic or Fresh link closes its flash box from both sides.

motion.name: mark-wave
motion.purpose: The wordmark wave: held frames at 30 fps.

motion.name: stepped-reveal
motion.purpose: Menu tiles arrive through blur and grain in 30 fps steps.

motion.name: key-strip-fade
motion.purpose: The key strip fades after three gestures or 8 s.

components.name: Chip (Bar v2)
components.description: The one control shape: a square slab on dark glass. Hover lifts it onto a hard shadow; a pick inverts it into the flash box.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 26px; min-width: 26px; margin: 0; padding: 0 10px; font: 500 11px/1 "Iosevka Term Slab", ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; color: var(--muted, oklch(0.64 0.02 275)); background: oklch(0.13 0.012 275 / 0.86); border: 1px solid var(--line, oklch(0.29 0.016 275)); border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--fg, oklch(0.94 0.008 275)); border-color: oklch(0.94 0.008 275 / 0.45); transform: translate(-1px, -1px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 oklch(0.05 0.01 275); } } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--bg, oklch(0.16 0.012 275)); background: var(--fg, oklch(0.94 0.008 275)); border-color: var(--fg, oklch(0.94 0.008 275)); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 oklch(0.07 0.01 275); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; }

narrative.overview:
Stimming is a dark shelf of toys. The page itself stays quiet: near-black violet ground, white type, hairlines. The colour belongs to the toys, to their icons and to the eight letters of the wordmark.
Tom's taste line governs every surface: "Daring, zany and original. Never skeuomorphic or fussy." Harmonograph and Music box were "way too involved". Bare-minimal is "too minimal". A menu concept must stay usable first.

Two voices share the screen. Gabarito speaks for the page (titles, prose). Iosevka Term Slab in caps speaks for the machine (toy labels, every Bar v2 control, keycaps). B612 carries the Stimming wordmark only, plus parts of the intro.
One device ties the intro, the controls and the build link together: the flash box. It is a white box with dark content cut out of it. The intro lands the logo in it. A picked control inverts into it.

A toy page puts play first. The stage fills the first screen. The controls sit in its four corners. Writing lives under the stage, and that zone is hidden today.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only. Every colour is OKLCH.
The shell has no accent colour of its own. Each toy brings one (`accent` in `toys.json`).
Square slab controls on dark glass, with hard offset shadows as a state signal.
The flash box: white fill, dark ink, used for the intro logo and for every picked control.
Motion in the shell runs in steps at 30 fps, not in smooth curves.
No browser interaction markers show: no ring, no tap flash, no selection.

rules.name: The Dark Only Rule
rules.body: There is one theme. `color-scheme: dark` is set on `:root` and in each page's meta tag. No light variant exists.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: The shell owns no accent. Colour comes from the toy (`accent`), the series (`color`) or the wordmark's letters. Shell chrome stays in the neutral family and in white.

rules.name: The White Title Rule
rules.body: In the Signal intro the logo takes the toy's ink. The title stays white (Tom, 2026-11-09).

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Gabarito is for names and writing. Iosevka Term Slab in caps is for labels and controls. Bar v2 moved every control to slab caps because round Gabarito pills were "off-brand" (`docs/plans/bar-v2.md`, Why 2).

rules.name: The Askew Mark Rule
rules.body: The wordmark's letters never sit straight. Each has its own weight, tilt (-8 to 7 degrees) and lift (-0.05 to 0.04 em), from `MARK`.

rules.name: The Shadow Is State Rule
rules.body: A hard shadow means hovered, picked or open. Nothing wears one at rest except a sheet.

rules.name: The Hard Shadow Scope Rule
rules.body: Hard offset shadows belong to Bar v2 controls and sheets. A menu icon never has one: no dark copy and no slab offset behind the shape (Tom, 2026-11-09). A soft halo is fine there.

dos: **Do** keep every surface dark, and write every colour in OKLCH.
**Do** take colour from the toy's `accent`, the series `color` or the wordmark's letters. Keep shell chrome neutral or white.
**Do** set control text in Iosevka Term Slab caps (500, 11 px, 0.07em) and writing in Gabarito.
**Do** box a thing only when it is a control. Leave the logo and the toy name unboxed and without shadow.
**Do** show a pick as the flash box: `--fg` fill, `--bg` text.
**Do** build a new toy page on Bar v2: one `bar` spec to `initPage`, five visible controls at most, the rest in Settings.
**Do** keep the intro logo's centre on `--origin`. Nothing moves it.
**Do** draw a menu icon as one bold object: one gradient body, `lit`, then a `rim` line 2 wide.
**Do** give every series the same thin ring in its own colour.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: the shell stops every transition and the entrance.
**Do** keep touch targets at 34 px or more on coarse pointers.
**Do** let the shell measure collisions. Check 1280 px, 375 × 812 and 812 × 375.
donts: **Don't** put a two-tone hard offset shadow on a menu icon: no dark copy and no slab offset behind the shape (Tom, 2026-11-09).
**Don't** draw an icon as a small model of the toy, or with dark outlines, thin lines, tiny parts or sparkle clutter (Tom, 2026-11-15). Draw no Stencil, Single-weight line or Abstract mark style.
**Don't** give a series icon a gold border, sparks, depth, tilt, wobble or sheen. No birds on the East Van and Belgium icons (Tom, 2026-11-15).
**Don't** put blurbs or taglines on the stage. Writing lives under it.
**Don't** colour the intro title. Only the logo takes the toy's ink.
**Don't** swap a live icon for a still copy.
**Don't** use a brand name for a toy (Tom's exceptions: Domino Day, Strandbeest).
**Don't** make it skeuomorphic or fussy, and don't make it bare-minimal.
**Don't** add a font or a library without Tom.
**Don't** build a new page on the v1 bar or restyle the shared bar from a toy.
